meta.query: Which drugs are combined with pembrolizumab?
meta.interpretation: Show drugs that are co-used with pembrolizumab in the same trial arm, filtering trials to those involving pembrolizumab.
notes: Drugs are interventions of type DRUG or BIOLOGICAL; placebos are excluded.
Entities are matched by name, ignoring case and spacing; spelling variants (e.g. brand vs generic names) are not merged.
Node trial_count is the number of trials registering the entity; edge trial_count is the number of trials registering both.
Showing 29 of 2487 entities, favouring the most frequent, and the strongest links between them (120).
Pembrolizumab is in 67% of the trials (the question's own filter); as an anchor it links to most entities by construction, so it is marked and left out of clustering.

Colours mark 4 clusters: entities linked more among themselves than to the rest (greedy modularity on shared trials, Q = 0.27), each named after its most frequent member. Entities in no cluster are linked only through anchors or to several clusters equally.
Edge association = shared trials / trials registering either entity (Jaccard, 0 to 1): high values mark entities that go together, such as a regimen, rather than merely frequent ones.

Arms tell how two drugs meet: combined = given together in one arm (an arm offering alternatives, "pembrolizumab or nivolumab", counts too); compared = only in different arms, e.g. pembrolizumab vs docetaxel. Links carry both counts (combined_trials, compared_trials), and their citations quote the arms.
Links count only trials giving both drugs in one arm: combinations.
6 of 2974 trials list no drugs per arm, so their pairs are neither combined nor compared.
